name: g72b_av_sheer_force
purpose: Alluring Voice from a Sheer Force holder (cross-row G61 x G72b, pool_families checkG61, decision 0015 5ce): Gardevoir (F) has Trace and copies Feraligatr's Sheer Force on the switch-in. On both turns Feraligatr (Jolly, faster) raises its Attack with Swords Dance first, so Alluring Voice hits a target whose stats rose this turn. Sheer Force strips the secondary: no confusion and no confusion draw; the move's base power gets the x5325/4096 boost instead (the pin's onModifyMove and onBasePower).
